cohort: 165 unaffected mothers of offspring with inherited bone marrow failure syndromes (IBMFS)
finding: Pregnancies in mothers with IBMFS-affected fetuses were high-risk, with higher rates of adverse events, particularly for offspring with early-onset severe phenotypes.
mod_finding: Offspring with Fanconi anemia, dyskeratosis congenita, and Diamond-Blackfan anemia had higher rates of adverse prenatal events and cesarean deliveries compared to unaffected offspring.
